'''Luranian brandy''' was a type of [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]] enjoyed by [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> It originated in the [[Lurania system/Legends|Lurania system]].<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Luranian brandy|system=[[Lurania system/Legends|Lurania system]]|legends=1}}</ref>
